upright.general: The Four of Swords indicates that the person being read for has isolated themselves from others. They don't want to see anyone, everything falls out of their hands, and there is stagnation in affairs. The main thing is not to withdraw into oneself, as this can turn into deep emotional disorders. It is necessary to ask for help from those nearby, and it will be granted. Visiting holy places will help stabilize the emotional state. Perhaps the person is currently ill. A speedy recovery awaits them in the near future, and then an optimistic mood will return. Another interpretation suggests that the person has committed an unseemly act or, conversely, some good deed. This card most often appears for workaholics. They work more than others, so they are literally falling off their feet and making mistakes at work. Rest is what the person needs first and foremost right now.
upright.in_love: A crisis situation has emerged in the relationship between partners. This is related to understatements, lack of trust in each other, and a cooling of feelings. The problems of this union run much deeper. The help of a psychologist is required. The fact that two people do not wish to sort out their relationship is not always a good thing. Mutual resentments and grievances accumulate, and silence only worsens the situation. Each of the partners lives their own isolated life. Can such a coexistence be called a union of two loving people? The Four of Swords suggests that something must be done immediately: either talk to each other, discussing their future life together, or break up. There is nowhere left to drag it out; a decision will have to be made.
upright.in_situation: If the question was about professional activity, then big problems will appear in business affairs. Good prospects are not expected yet. The card says that there might not be enough time to implement the planned goals. The person being read for is disliked in the collective, and many rumors are woven around them. Even those colleagues who seem to be friends are envious in some way and are not sincere toward them. The situation may reach a point where they might have to leave the job.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today is the day when a decision must be made. As much as you might want to delay this moment, there is no pushing it off any further. The decision may concern one of the spheres of life. After taking this important step, a person will immediately feel relieved. The card also means that a person is highly susceptible to foreign influence. One needs to learn to live by their own intellect, but at the same time wisely make use of the advice from others.
upright.card_advice: The person being read for needs to figure things out with themselves and spend some time alone. In solitude, they should think about what their future plans will be. This is necessary so that thoughtless actions do not cause harm or inflict severe emotional trauma.

reversed.general: Development, progress, movement—this is what the reversed Four of Swords says. It cannot be argued that the card carries an absolutely positive interpretation, as sudden changes can knock anyone out of their groove. Perhaps there is currently a period of recovery after a long illness. The person may develop insomnia. One shouldn't throw themselves into work with great enthusiasm after a long break; everything must be done gradually. The card says that the person is too stingy in their desire to save money. The card also suggests that a personality will soon appear whom people in society try to avoid. Maybe a meeting with someone prone to offenses awaits the person.
reversed.in_love: The reversed Four of Swords says that a disagreeable conversation with the partner will take place in the near future. The person being read for has decided to commit an act that is not very honorable toward their partner. Maybe they have another lover, and the one who is currently beside them is no longer needed. Living on two fronts is not an option. Sooner or later, the deception will be uncovered, and troubles will happen anyway. If the person is single, a meeting awaits them with someone who will seem like a good candidate for a life companion. One shouldn't rush. Perhaps this is not the person they need.
reversed.in_situation: The person being read for may meet with not entirely honorable people. This could be an entertainment establishment where, under the influence of alcohol, actions might be committed that will lead to regret. Doubtful acquaintances rarely bring benefits. When a person begins to analyze their behavior, very often they repent of what they have done. To prevent this, the card warns the person to control their actions. Plans and creative ideas will not be implemented in the near future; a longer time is needed for this. The card states that the person cannot pull themselves together, allows themselves to be manipulated, and is unorganized. They are hovering in the clouds, and they need to soberly assess their life so as not to let themselves be used and to carefully think things through.
reversed.meaning_for_today: The period of rest or waiting is coming to an end. Today may bring a need to re-engage with responsibilities, conversations, or situations that have been postponed. While you may not feel fully prepared, progress requires movement. Be mindful not to rush blindly into action, but do not remain stuck in avoidance or indecision either. Small, deliberate steps forward will be more productive than continued hesitation.
reversed.card_advice: Do not mistake inactivity for healing or avoidance for peace. It is time to apply what you have learned during your period of reflection and begin moving forward. Stay grounded, organized, and aware of your priorities. Avoid distractions, impulsive choices, and people who drain your energy. Recovery and growth happen when reflection is followed by purposeful action.
